gtfsrt2static: Realized Static GTFS Snapshots from GTFS-Realtime and GPS-Derived Observations

Source: R/gtfsrt2static-package.R
gtfsrt2static-package.Rd

Converts archived GTFS-Realtime feeds ('Trip Updates', 'Vehicle Positions') and GPS-derived observations into standard-compliant static GTFS snapshots that describe public transit service as actually operated. Provides a canonical observed-stop-events table that both input paths converge on, an assembler that merges observations into a baseline static feed or scaffolds a compliant feed from scratch, and a lightweight collector for continuously archiving ephemeral GTFS-Realtime endpoints.
